about: Curated replacements for villa Python modules and names that villa PR #2440, the vc_reader takeover (https://github.com/ScrollPrize/villa/pull/2440, merged 4 Nov 2026 as baf5e605b), removed or moved; read by kit/villaports.py. Each entry was read from the villa diff of the commit it names. 'villa' is the file in villa's tree at that commit that holds the replacement; 'use' says how villa's own callers were ported. Where 'use' says 'by name', the counterpart was matched by its name and role, not by a villa caller: check the arguments. Packages: where each villa Python package lives in villa's tree (the first folder with an __init__.py wins).

entries.name: Volume
entries.use: scroll volumes are read with vc_reader: vc_reader.reader.open_zarr(path_or_url, level=...) returns a ZarrReader you slice (villa's own calls pass level=, auth= and threads=); vesuvius.data.volume now holds only Cube, and its docstring says to use vc_reader for scroll volumes. Volume's normalization_scheme has no argument here: apply vc_reader.transforms.Normalize to the slice (by name)

vesuvius.data.utils is gone: zarr reads go through vc_reader.reader.open_zarr(path, level=...) and open_group, writes through vc_reader.reader.create_group and ZarrWriter

from vc_reader import tifxyz: tifxyz.read(path, mask=True) returns a tifxyz.Surface (.xyz, .points_at), tifxyz.write(path, surface, overwrite=True), tifxyz.list_surfaces(folder) gives entries with .location

entries.name: Tifxyz
entries.use: vc_reader.tifxyz.Surface(xyz, uuid=..., bbox=...) in place of Tifxyz (villa's ports: Surface(grid_zyx[..., ::-1]) then Surface(s.xyz, uuid=..., bbox=s.bounds()))

entries.name: read_tifxyz
entries.use: vc_reader.tifxyz.read(path) (mask=False for the raw stored grid) in place of read_tifxyz

entries.name: write_tifxyz
entries.use: vc_reader.tifxyz.write(path, surface, overwrite=True) in place of write_tifxyz(folder / uuid, surface, overwrite=True); write takes the full output path and returns nothing

entries.name: list_tifxyz
entries.use: vc_reader.tifxyz.list_surfaces(folder, recursive=True); each entry's .location goes to tifxyz.read

entries.name: upsampling
entries.use: tifxyz.Surface(xyz).points_at(rows, cols, interpolation="bicubic") returns (xyz, valid) in place of upsampling.interpolate_at_points(..., method="catmull_rom")
tifxyz.Surface(xyz).points_at(rows, cols, interpolation="bicubic") returns (xyz, valid) in place of interpolate_at_points(..., method="catmull_rom")
moved to vesuvius.neural_tracing.inference.surface_store (git rename, 74 percent similar)

entries.name: full_resolution_extent
entries.use: vc_reader.tifxyz.full_extent(stored, scale) in place of full_resolution_extent

vesuvius.image_proc is gone: its filters are vc_reader.transforms configs (Normalize, StructureTensor, CoherenceEnhancingDiffusion, Ridges, DistanceTransform, GaussianBlur) and vc_reader.geometry (label_components); its label scripts moved to vesuvius.label_processing

vc_reader.transforms.Normalize(mode, ...) with mode minmax, zscore, robust, percentile or fixed, applied per channel to a (C, ...) array; villa ports its own callers through vesuvius.ink_detection.data.normalization.normalize_image(x, NormalizationConfig(mode=...))

entries.name: normalize_robust
entries.use: normalize_image(x, NormalizationConfig(mode="robust_mad")) from vesuvius.ink_detection.data.normalization and vesuvius.ink_detection.config (villa's own port of normalize_robust; defaults 1 and 99 percent, as before), which runs vc_reader.transforms.Normalize("robust", lower=1, upper=99) over the whole array

entries.name: normalize_zscore
entries.use: vc_reader.transforms.Normalize("zscore") (population std; nonzero=True excludes zeros by default)

entries.name: normalize_minmax
entries.use: vc_reader.transforms.Normalize("minmax")

entries.name: StructureTensorComputer
entries.use: vc_reader.transforms.StructureTensor(on="image", sigma=...) (by name)
moved to vesuvius.label_processing.refine_labels (git rename, 69 percent similar)
moved to vesuvius.label_processing.voxelize_objs

import vc_reader.transforms as A and compose configs in A.Pipeline([...], targets=...): villa's training pipeline replaced MirrorTransform with A.Flip and Rot90Transform with A.Rotate90; by name, TransposeAxesTransform is A.Transpose, GaussianBlurTransform A.GaussianBlur, GaussianNoiseTransform A.GaussianNoise, GammaTransform A.Gamma, ContrastTransform A.Contrast, BrightnessAdditiveTransform A.BrightnessAdd, MultiplicativeBrightnessTransform A.BrightnessMultiply, SpatialTransform A.Affine and A.Elastic, SimulateLowResolutionTransform A.LowResolution, OneOfTransform A.OneOf; the class bases (BasicTransform, ImageOnlyTransform) have no counterpart
random parameters are configs: A.Uniform(low, high), A.Normal(mean, std), A.Choice(values) from vc_reader.transforms in place of RandomScalar and sample_scalar
the label pyramid helpers moved to vesuvius.ink_detection.label_zarr (pyramid_shapes, CHUNK_SHAPE, LABEL_CODEC); zarr itself goes through vc_reader.reader

entries.name: open_v2_group
entries.use: vc_reader.reader.create_group(path, attrs=..., overwrite=True, auth=None) in place of open_v2_group(path)

entries.name: create_v2_array
entries.use: group.create_array(name, shape=..., chunks=..., dtype=..., cname="zstd", level=3, shuffle=2, separator="/", skip_empty=True) on a vc_reader.reader.create_group group in place of create_v2_array(group, ...)

entries.name: LABEL_COMPRESSOR
entries.use: LABEL_CODEC (a dict: cname zstd, level 3, shuffle 2) from vesuvius.ink_detection.label_zarr, passed as create_array(**LABEL_CODEC), in place of the Blosc LABEL_COMPRESSOR

entries.name: CTVolume
entries.use: the CT is read with vc_reader.reader.open_zarr(spec.ct_zarr, level=spec.ct_level, cache_dir=spec.cache_dir, memory_cache=...); CTVolumeSpec stays in crop_sampling.volume
zarr reads go through vc_reader.reader (open_zarr, open_group, ZarrReader, ZarrWriter)
S3 access goes through vc_reader.reader (ObjectStore, open_zarr with auth)
renamed to vesuvius.fiber_spline_generator (same files)
